00069 void LLineUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00070 {   
00071     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00072     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00073     
00074     if(increment > 0.f) {
00075         while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00076         {
00077             // perhaps the increment should happen after the first sample output?
00078             // this is they way I'm going to do the Linen class below
00079             //currentValue += increment;
00080             
00081             if(currentValue >= end_) {
00082                 *outputSamples++ = end_;
00083                 while(numSamplesToProcess--)  {
00084                     *outputSamples++ = end_;
00085                 }
00086                 shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00087                 break;
00088             }
00089             else
00090             {
00091                 *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00092                 currentValue += increment;
00093             }
00094         }
00095     } else {
00096         while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00097         {
00098             //currentValue += increment;
00099             
00100             if(currentValue <= end_) {
00101                 *outputSamples++ = end_;
00102                 while(numSamplesToProcess--)  {
00103                     *outputSamples++ = end_;
00104                 }
00105                 shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00106                 break;
00107             }
00108             else
00109             {
00110                 *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00111                 currentValue += increment;
00112             }
00113         }
00114     }
00115 }

00123 void LLineUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00124 {   
00125     const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00126     unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;
00127     const double krIncrement = increment * krBlockSize;
00128     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00129     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00130     
00131     int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;
00132     
00133     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00134     {
00135         float nextValue = currentValue;
00136         
00137         if(numKrSamples == 0 && nextValue != end_)
00138         {
00139             nextValue += krIncrement;
00140             
00141             if((increment > 0.0 && nextValue >= end_) || 
00142                (increment < 0.0 && nextValue <= end_))
00143             {
00144                 nextValue = end_;
00145                 shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00146             }
00147         }
00148         
00149         numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00150         blockPosition += numKrSamples;
00151         
00152         
00153         if(nextValue == currentValue)
00154         {
00155             while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00156             {
00157                 *outputSamples++ = nextValue;
00158                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00159                 --numKrSamples;
00160             }
00161         }
00162         else
00163         {
00164             float valueSlope = (nextValue - currentValue) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();
00165             
00166             while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00167             {
00168                 *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00169                 currentValue += valueSlope;
00170                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00171                 --numKrSamples;
00172             }
00173             
00174             currentValue = nextValue;
00175         }
00176     }       
00177 }

00180 LLine::LLine(Buffer const& start,   
00181              Buffer const& end,
00182              Buffer const& duration,
00183              const UGen::DoneAction doneAction) throw()
00184 {
00185     Buffer inputs[] = { start, end, duration };
00186     const int numInputChannels = findMaxInputSizes(numElementsInArray(inputs), inputs);
00187     initInternal(numInputChannels);
00188     
00189     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00190     {
00191         ugen_assert(duration.wrapAt(i) > 0.f);
00192         
00193         internalUGens[i] = new LLineUGenInternal(start.wrapAt(i), 
00194                                                  end.wrapAt(i), 
00195                                                  duration.wrapAt(i), 
00196                                                  doneAction);
00197     }
00198 }

00200 XLine::XLine(Buffer const& startBuffer, 
00201              Buffer const& endBuffer,
00202              Buffer const& durationBuffer,
00203              const UGen::DoneAction doneAction) throw()
00204 {   
00205     Buffer inputs[] = { startBuffer, endBuffer, durationBuffer };
00206     const int numInputChannels = findMaxInputSizes(numElementsInArray(inputs), inputs);
00207     initInternal(numInputChannels);
00208     
00209     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00210     {       
00211         const float start = startBuffer.wrapAt(i);
00212         const float end = endBuffer.wrapAt(i);
00213         const float duration = durationBuffer.wrapAt(i);
00214         
00215         ugen_assert(duration > 0.f);        
00216         
00217         UGen xline;
00218         
00219         if((start > 0.f && end > 0.f) || (start < 0.f && end < 0.f))
00220         {
00221             // real exponential
00222             Env env = Env(Buffer((double)start, (double)end), duration, EnvCurve::Exponential); 
00223             xline = EnvGen::AR(env, doneAction);
00224         }
00225         else
00226         {       
00227             // pseudo exponential where start or end are zero or the line crosses zero
00228             
00229             const float epsilon = 0.0001f;
00230             
00231             if(start < 0.f && end > 0.f) {
00232                 Env env = Env(Buffer((double)epsilon, (double)(end - start + epsilon)), duration, EnvCurve::Exponential);   
00233                 xline = EnvGen::AR(env, doneAction) - (epsilon - start);
00234             }
00235             else if(start > 0.f && end < 0.f) {
00236                 Env env = Env(Buffer((double)(start - end + epsilon), (double)epsilon), duration, EnvCurve::Exponential);   
00237                 xline = EnvGen::AR(env, doneAction) - (epsilon - end);
00238             }
00239             else if(start == 0.f) {
00240                 if(end > 0.f) {
00241                     Env env = Env(Buffer((double)(start + epsilon), (double)(end + epsilon)), duration, EnvCurve::Exponential); 
00242                     xline = EnvGen::AR(env, doneAction) - epsilon;
00243                 } else {
00244                     Env env = Env(Buffer((double)(start - epsilon), (double)(end - epsilon)), duration, EnvCurve::Exponential); 
00245                     xline = EnvGen::AR(env, doneAction) + epsilon;
00246                 }
00247             }
00248             else if(end == 0.f) {
00249                 if(start > 0.f) {
00250                     Env env = Env(Buffer((double)(start + epsilon), (double)(end + epsilon)), duration, EnvCurve::Exponential); 
00251                     xline = EnvGen::AR(env, doneAction) - epsilon;
00252                 } else {
00253                     Env env = Env(Buffer((double)(start - epsilon), (double)(end - epsilon)), duration, EnvCurve::Exponential); 
00254                     xline = EnvGen::AR(env, doneAction) + epsilon;
00255                 }
00256             }
00257         }
00258         
00259         internalUGens[i] = new ThruUGenInternal(xline);
00260     }
00261 }

00268 LinenUGenInternal::LinenUGenInternal(const float attackTime, 
00269                                      const float sustainTime, 
00270                                      const float releaseTime, 
00271                                      const float sustainLevel, 
00272                                      const UGen::DoneAction doneAction) throw()
00273 :   UGenInternal(0),
00274     attackTime_(attackTime), 
00275     sustainTime_(sustainTime), 
00276     releaseTime_(releaseTime),
00277     sustainLevel_(sustainLevel),
00278     currentSegment(AttackSegment),
00279     numSustainSamplesRemaining(sustainTime_ * UGen::getSampleRate()),
00280     currentValue(0.0), 
00281     increment(sustainLevel * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate() / attackTime_),
00282     doneAction_(doneAction),
00283     shouldDeleteValue(doneAction_ == UGen::DeleteWhenDone)
00284 {
00285     // assert if duration is negative?
00286 }

00289 {

00293 
00294 void LinenUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00295 {   
00296     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00297     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00298     
00299     // fall through each of these switch..case (purposefully no breaks)
00300     switch (currentSegment) 
00301     {
00302         case AttackSegment:
00303             if(attackTime_ <= 0.f)
00304             {
00305                 currentValue = sustainLevel_;
00306                 if(sustainTime_ <= 0.f)
00307                 {
00308                     if(releaseTime_ <= 0.f)
00309                         currentSegment = EnvDone;
00310                     else
00311                         currentSegment = ReleaseSegment;
00312                 }
00313                 else
00314                     currentSegment = SustainSegment;
00315             }
00316                 
00317             while(numSamplesToProcess && currentSegment == AttackSegment)
00318             {
00319                 *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00320                 currentValue += increment;
00321                 
00322                 if(currentValue >= sustainLevel_) {
00323                     currentValue = sustainLevel_;
00324                     if(sustainTime_ <= 0.f)
00325                         currentSegment = ReleaseSegment;
00326                     else
00327                         currentSegment = SustainSegment;
00328                 }
00329                 
00330                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00331             }
00332 
00333         case SustainSegment:
00334             while(numSamplesToProcess && currentSegment == SustainSegment)
00335             {
00336                 *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00337 
00338                 if(--numSustainSamplesRemaining == 0) {
00339                     if(releaseTime_ < 0.f)
00340                         currentSegment = EnvDone;
00341                     else
00342                     {
00343                         currentSegment = ReleaseSegment;
00344                         increment = sustainLevel_ * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate() / releaseTime_;
00345                     }
00346                 }
00347                 
00348                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00349             }
00350             
00351         case ReleaseSegment:
00352             while(numSamplesToProcess && currentSegment == ReleaseSegment)
00353             {
00354                 *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00355                 currentValue -= increment;
00356                 
00357                 if(currentValue <= 0.f) {
00358                     currentValue = 0.f;
00359                     currentSegment = EnvDone;
00360                 }
00361                 
00362                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00363             }
00364             
00365         case EnvDone:
00366         default:
00367             while(numSamplesToProcess) 
00368             {
00369                 *outputSamples++ = 0.f;
00370                 shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00371                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00372             }
00373             
00374     }
00375     
00376 }

00388 void LinenUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00389 {   
00390     const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00391     unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;
00392     double krIncrement = increment * krBlockSize;
00393     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00394     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00395     
00396     int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;
00397     
00398     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00399     {
00400         if(numKrSamples == 0)
00401         {
00402             switch (currentSegment) 
00403             {
00404                 case AttackSegment:
00405                     currentValue += krIncrement;
00406                     if(currentValue >= sustainLevel_)
00407                     {
00408                         currentValue = sustainLevel_;
00409                         currentSegment = SustainSegment;
00410                     }
00411                     break;
00412                 case SustainSegment:
00413                     numSustainSamplesRemaining -= krBlockSize;
00414                     if(numSustainSamplesRemaining <= 0)
00415                     {
00416                         currentSegment = ReleaseSegment;
00417                         increment = sustainLevel_ * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate() / releaseTime_;
00418                         krIncrement = increment * krBlockSize;
00419                     }
00420                     break;
00421                 case ReleaseSegment:
00422                     currentValue -= krIncrement;
00423                     if(currentValue <= 0.f)
00424                     {
00425                         currentValue = 0.f;
00426                         currentSegment = EnvDone;
00427                         
00428                         shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00429                     }
00430                     break;
00431                 case EnvDone:
00432                 default:
00433                     currentValue = 0.f;
00434                     break;
00435             }
00436         }
00437         
00438         numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00439         blockPosition += numKrSamples;
00440         
00441         while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00442         {
00443             *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00444             --numSamplesToProcess;
00445             --numKrSamples;
00446         }
00447     }       
00448 }
